title: 2000 yil: Blockbuster Netflix'ni 50 million dollarga olmadi

scenes.text: 2000 yilda Netflix asoschilari kompaniyani Blockbuster'ga 50 million dollarga sotishni taklif qilishdi.
scenes.keywords: businessmen in suits meeting office handshake declined

scenes.text: Rid Xastings va Mark Rendolf Dallasda Blockbuster rahbari Jon Antioko bilan uchrashdi; u rad etdi.
scenes.keywords: two men walking into corporate building lobby

scenes.text: Netflix to'xtamadi va 2007 yil yanvarida filmlarni internetda ko'rsatishni boshladi.
scenes.keywords: person streaming movie on laptop at night

scenes.text: 2010 yil sentabrida Blockbuster bankrotlikka ariza berdi.
scenes.keywords: empty closed store going out of business sign

scenes.text: Bugun kichik ko'ringan raqib ertaga butun bozorni o'zgartirishi mumkin.

description: 2000 yilda Netflix asoschilari kompaniyani Blockbuster'ga 50 million dollarga sotishni taklif qilgan, Blockbuster rad etgan. Uchrashuv tafsilotlari Mark Rendolfning 2019 yilgi kitobi va asoschilar hikoyasiga tayanadi. Netflix 2007 yil yanvarida filmlarni internet orqali ko'rsatishni boshladi, Blockbuster esa 2010 yil sentabrida bankrotlikka ariza berdi. Siz qaysi kichik raqibni hozir jiddiy qabul qilmayapsiz?
source: Marketplace, Reed Hastings on how Netflix beat Blockbuster (2020), https://marketplace.org/2020/09/08/ceo-reed-hastings-on-how-netflix-beat-blockbuster ; Fortune, Marc Randolph recalls Blockbuster rejecting chance to buy Netflix (2023), https://fortune.com/2023/04/14/netflix-cofounder-marc-randolph-recalls-blockbuster-rejecting-chance-to-buy-netflix/ ; Newsweek fact check, https://newsweek.com/fact-check-did-blockbuster-turn-downchance-buy-netflix-50-million-1575557 ; Quartz, Netflix launched streaming 16 January 2007, https://qz.com/887010/netflix-nflx-launched-streaming-video-10-years-ago-and-changed-the-way-we-watch-everything ; Engadget, Blockbuster files for Chapter 11 on 23 September 2010, https://www.engadget.com/2010-09-23-blockbuster-files-for-chapter-11.html
